sentences.text:
Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application is disposed of.
1. By way of present petitioner, the petitioner seeks quashing of FIR No.119/2021 registered under Sections 376/506 IPC at PS South Rohini, Delhi.
3. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and submits that the prosecutrix/respondent No.2 has already passed away and there are no other family members.

Let the Status Report/reply, if any, be placed on record before the next date of hearing, which shall also indicate the previous involvements of the petitioner, if any.
4. List on 20.02.2025.
